subject: Human Evolution
title: The S-Shaped Spine
description: A micro-lesson that makes The S-Shaped Spine usable.

hook.text: Apes have a single C-curve spine. Humans have an S-curve. That extra bend keeps us from falling forward.

buildup.text: The lumbar lordosis—an inward curve in the lower back—positions our center of gravity directly over our hips.

discovery.text: Without this curve, walking upright would require constant muscular effort just to stay balanced.

twist.text: The S-curve is a hack, not a design. It's why humans get lower back pain—a leftover from our quadruped past.

climax.text: Evolution doesn't start from scratch. It bends old parts into new shapes, flaws and all.

punchline.text: Your back pain is 4 million years in the making.
